target_customer: Digital health and telehealth practices that need to sync patient data across EHR and other tools
problem: Healthcare providers manually move patient data between intake forms, EHRs and insurance checks.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with a free tier

founders.name: Montana Scher
education: Stanford, product design and computer science
founders.background_notes: YC page: first product hire at Parsley Health.

founders.name: James Thompson
founders.background_notes: YC page: built data models and pipelines at early stage health-tech and fintech/data companies; employers and education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: HIPAA compliance and many EHR integrations are laborious but standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded workflows create some lock in, but integration platforms are replicable.

market_need_then: Founders cite problems faced at Parsley Health; the pitch is Segment plus Zapier for providers.

identity.logo: Letter M mark per a directory listing
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, benefit focused: 'Focus on care, automate the rest'

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Morf is active and raised a $3M seed in November 2023 led by Kindred Ventures, about 16 months after the batch. It now sells to digital health practices with an AI workflow builder. No exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is still developing.
notes: Seed confirmed by Business Wire and Pulse 2.0 titles seen in search results (Business Wire page returned 403 on fetch). Some aggregators give $3.5M total including a YC amount, unverified. Competitor sources (Redox, Rhapsody, Keragon) are dated 2025 or later, so the list is empty. Kindred Ventures Medium Q&A not opened.
